newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ L 138 of May 29, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ L 138 of May 29, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

COMMISSION DECISION of 5 May 1997 on the clearance of the accounts of Member States' expenditure financed by the European Agricultural Guidance and Guarantee Fund (EAGGF), Guarantee Section, for the 1996 financial year
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 949/97 of 28 May 1997 fixing the import duties in the rice sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 948/97 of 28 May 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 947/97 of 28 May 1997 fixing the maximum export refunds for olive oil for the 13th partial invitation to tender under the standing invitation to tender issued by Regulation (EC) No 2081/96

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 946/97 of 28 May 1997 amending Regulation (EC) No 1172/96 adopting the balance and fixing the aid for the supply of breeding rabbits to the Canary Islands under the arrangements provided for in Article 4 of Council Regulation (EEC) No 1601/92

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 945/97 of 28 May 1997 determining the quantity available for the third quarter of 1997 of certain products in the milk and milk products sector covered by the arrangements provided for in the Interim Agreement concluded by the Community with the Republic of Slovenia
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 944/97 of 28 May 1997 correcting Regulation (EC) No 198/97 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 943/97 of 27 May 1997 establishing unit values for the determination of the customs value of certain perishable goods

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 942/97 of 28 May 1997 fixing the maximum export refund for white sugar for the 40th partial invitation to tender issued within the framework of the standing invitation to tender provided for in Regulation (EC) No 1464/96
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 941/97 of 28 May 1997 fixing the export refunds on white sugar and raw sugar exported in its unaltered state
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 940/97 of 28 May 1997 fixing the representative prices and the additional import duties for molasses in the sugar sector

Corrigendum to Commission Regulation (EC) No 194/97 of 31 January 1997 setting maximum levels for certain contaminants in foodstuffs (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 31 of 1 February 1997) END OF DOCUMENT.
